title.context: Settings: card heading. The app opens in four stages so a new user isn't overwhelmed; this card picks the stage and switches features on or off.

help.message: Learn it a step at a time. Each stage adds one habit; nothing is deleted, only hidden, and it's this phone's choice.
help.context: Settings > What the app shows: help under the heading.

stageN.context: Small label above a stage's name. {n} is 1 to 4.

current.context: Settings > What the app shows: badge on the stage this phone is at.

custom.context: Settings > What the app shows: added to the current stage's badge when features were switched on or off by hand.

choose.context: Settings > What the app shows: button on a stage card.

readLesson.context: Settings > What the app shows: button that opens a stage's lesson.

customize.context: Settings > What the app shows: button that shows a switch per feature.

customizeHide.context: Settings > What the app shows: button that hides the per-feature switches.

reset.message: Back to what the stage shows
reset.context: Settings > What the app shows: button that undoes features switched by hand.

adds.context: Stage card and lesson: label before the list of features the stage adds.

addsNothing.message: Adding expenses and income, History, and the charts of where it goes.
addsNothing.context: Stage 1 card: what the first stage shows, as it adds no feature of its own.

why.context: Lesson sheet: heading of the paragraph on why this stage's habit matters.

toDo.context: Lesson sheet: heading of the list of things to do in this stage.

unlock.context: Lesson sheet: button that moves this phone to the next stage. {name} is the stage's name.

later.context: Next-stage suggestion: button that puts it off for two weeks.

nudge.context: Add screen: a small banner when the habit of the current stage has taken. {name} is the next stage's name.

nudgeLabel.context: Add screen: accessible label of the next-stage banner.

dismiss.context: Add screen: accessible label of the button that hides the next-stage banner for two weeks.

name.context: Stage 1 name: logging what's spent and earned.

why.message: Before you can plan anything you need to know what a month really costs. Most people guess their spending 20–30% too low: the big buys stick, the small ones don't.

do1.message: Log every expense right away: category, amount, Save. Three taps.
do1.context: Stage 1 lesson: first thing to do.

do2.message: When pay comes in, log it with the arrow next to the amount at the top.
do2.context: Stage 1 lesson: second thing to do.

do3.message: Once a week, swipe through the widgets: where it goes, Top 3, where the pay went.
do3.context: Stage 1 lesson: third thing to do.

next.message: After two weeks of logging, the app suggests planning a month.
next.context: Stage 1 lesson: when the next stage is suggested.

why.message: A budget isn't a ban, it's deciding in advance what the money is for. When every złoty has a job (a zero-based budget), you see where the rest slips away.

do1.message: On the Budget tab, plan the month: income, what to put aside, a limit per category.
do1.context: Stage 2 lesson: first thing to do.

do2.message: Start from Typical: what each category has cost over the last months.
do2.context: Stage 2 lesson: second thing to do.

do3.message: Glance at the amount at the top of the Add screen: that's what's still safe to spend.
do3.context: Stage 2 lesson: third thing to do.

next.message: With a plan and a paycheck logged, the app suggests saving from it.
next.context: Stage 2 lesson: when the next stage is suggested.

name.context: Stage 3 name: saving first, goals, an emergency fund.

why.message: Put money aside at the start of the month, not from what's left: usually nothing is. The first goal is an emergency fund, three to six months of spending for what you can't plan.

do1.message: Add your savings accounts with today's balance.
do1.context: Stage 3 lesson: first thing to do.

do2.message: Make an emergency fund goal and mark it as one in its sheet.
do2.context: Stage 3 lesson: second thing to do.

do3.message: On payday, use From the paycheck to pay in what the plan puts aside.
do3.context: Stage 3 lesson: third thing to do.

next.message: After two months of it, the app suggests the full picture.
next.context: Stage 3 lesson: when the next stage is suggested.

why.message: Now the whole picture: debts and the way out of them, net worth, bills that come once a year, how old your money is, and the road to living off savings.

do1.message: Add your debts and see when you'd be debt-free, dearest or smallest first.
do1.context: Stage 4 lesson: first thing to do.

do2.message: Add subscriptions and yearly bills: the app works out what to put aside a month.
do2.context: Stage 4 lesson: second thing to do.

do3.message: Once a quarter, bring account and debt balances up to date.
do3.context: Stage 4 lesson: third thing to do.

next.message: That's all of it. Any feature can still be switched off here.
